meta.title: 短视频带货、代拍素材、拍摄技巧、桌拍
meta.title_en: Short-Video Product Filming: Desk Shoot Skills

scenes.context: 不要这样拿相机，要学会有活动感地转动，避免画面死板。
sentences: Don't hold the camera like this.
要学会有活动感地转动。
Learn to move with a lively feel.
paraphrase: 用hold the camera换一种说法
Don't hold the camera like this.
Learn to move with a lively feel.
scenes.speak: Don't hold the camera like this. Learn to move with a lively feel.

scenes.context: 拿的时候不要这样，会撞到头、晃动镜头，要让动作顺滑。
sentences: Holding it like this makes it swing.
paraphrase: Holding it like this makes it swing.
scenes.speak: Holding it like this makes it swing. Make the motion smoother.

scenes.context: 拍上手展示时不要把产品拍得粗大，要拉高手机找画面的延伸。
sentences: Don't make the product look huge.
Raise the phone to extend the composition.
paraphrase: Don't make the product look huge.
Raise the phone to extend the composition.
scenes.speak: Don't make the product look huge. Raise the phone to extend the composition.

scenes.context: 转动的时候不要用手机画圈，很生硬；要先放再后推，动作有节奏。
sentences: Pull back slowly for better rhythm.
paraphrase: Pull back slowly for better rhythm.
scenes.speak: Don't circle the phone around. Pull back slowly for better rhythm.

scenes.context: 拍平平挂挂的产品时不要干拍，要学会把产品翻转过来看，展示不同面。
sentences: Learn to flip the product over.
paraphrase: Learn to flip the product over.
scenes.speak: Learn to flip the product over. Show every side of it.

scenes.context: 指点的时候不要没节奏地乱点，可以转、可以停，配合画面重心。
sentences: Match the visual center of the frame.
paraphrase: Match the visual center of the frame.
scenes.speak: Point with rhythm, not randomly. Match the visual center of the frame.

practice: 拍上手展示时拉高手机，怎么说？
Raise the phone when showing the product.
Learn to flip the product over.
pitfalls: 让镜头有活动感地转动
拍上手展示时手机拿太低
低角度会把产品拍得粗大
